text.en: This weapon emits a powerful impulse that pushes enemies away, suppresses their abilities, and makes them more vulnerable to all incoming damage.

Intrinsically <overload/>Anti-Overload.

Fires a powerful <void/>Void Blast that knocks back enemies. <link Minibosses and Bosses [#CombatantClassifications] /> are unaffected by knockback.

Hits apply <void/>Suppression as well as a higher tier <void/>Weaken that increases all damage dealt to the target by 30% for 10 seconds.
